description:
Generate a caption

Generate a social media caption with AI, optionally grounded in a content group's brand profile. Counts as 1 AI text generation.

contentGroupId.description: Content group whose brand profile grounds the caption

context.description: What the caption is for, e.g. "product launch post". Default: "social media post"

existingContent.description: Existing caption to improve or rewrite

name: generateCaption
